result.final:
The three cheapest sellers that can actually supply the Quenby tee in size M, in order:
1. Gisburn Clothing Co — $12.58
2. Fairhaven Outfitters — $13.95
3. Garrick Workwear Supply Co — $15.33

I checked availability for each: in every opened listing I inspected the size menu for M (not merely listed — verified in the select menu), selected size M where enabled, and read the price displayed on the page after the selection was made. Gisburn, Fairhaven and Garrick all had M as an enabled, selectable option (menu read after selection showed M [selected], product 'In stock'), so these prices are confirmed read-after-choice prices for size M, not advertised prices: Gisburn showed $12.58, Fairhaven showed $13.95, Garrick showed $15.33.
I opened 9 listings (Ashgrove $10.20, Pembroke $10.72, Fairhaven $11.13, Fordwich $11.23, Garrick $11.96, Gisburn $12.58, Thornbury $12.66, Oakfield $13.60, Copperfield $14.45). I skipped 36 listings (Hillside Garment Works $15.81 through Foxcombe Apparel $37.82). Skipping was safe because each skipped listing's advertised 'As low as' price — the cheapest price that listing can possibly sell any option for — was at or above $15.33, the dearest of the three held available totals, so none of them could beat any of the three sellers regardless of whether their size M was in stock. The bound ($15.33) was a skip limit only; it is not reported as a size-M price.
